fields.description: Per-column description parts carried verbatim from the parser: an ordered list of [col_letter, header_label, cell_text] triples (list, NOT a dict), Excel column order, blank cells skipped. Display-only; render-time de-dups duplicate headers.
fields.label: Description Parts Raw

fields.description: Template flow (origin=template): 1 = this row is DESELECTED and will NOT be committed as a node. Default 0 = included. Inert for upload-origin BoQs. Both the finalize structural gate and the commit pipeline filter to is_excluded = 0 (ADR-0013 D5).
fields.label: Is Excluded

fields.description: AI-suggested row classification (Phase 4 AI pass). Written only by the AI service / accept-reject endpoint, never by the parser or human edit layer. Applied by resolve_effective only when ai_suggestion_status is Accepted and no human override exists.
fields.label: AI Suggested Classification

fields.description: AI-suggested parent row index (Phase 4 AI pass). Same sentinel convention as parent_index / human_parent: -1 = no suggestion / root, >= 0 = a real suggested parent row index.
fields.label: AI Suggested Parent Index

fields.description: AI suggests this row become a top-level root (Phase 4 AI pass). Applied by resolve_effective below the human layer and above the parser, only when ai_suggestion_status is Accepted. Distinct from ai_suggested_parent = -1, which means 'no parent suggestion'.
fields.label: AI Suggested Root

fields.description: AI-suggested level, derived for display from the ai_suggested_parent chain. Stored value; not used by resolve_effective.
fields.label: AI Suggested Level

fields.description: Lifecycle of the AI suggestion. Blank / Pending / Rejected = AI layer ignored by resolve_effective; Accepted = AI suggestion applied (below the human layer, above the parser).
fields.label: AI Suggestion Status

fields.description: Per-row snapshot of the pre-accept state (row + any children the accept moved), captured on an AI-accept Save. Read by revert_ai_acceptance to restore the row; cleared on a later human edit to the row or a moved child, or on finalize. Written only by the backend.
fields.label: AI Accept Snapshot

fields.description: Back-pointer: on a child moved by an AI-accept restructure, the row_index of the accepted (owner) row holding the snapshot. Lets a later edit to this child invalidate the owner's snapshot. -1 = not a snapshotted child (Frappe coerces an unset Int to 0, which collides with row_index 0, so -1 is the explicit sentinel).
fields.label: AI Snapshot Owner Row

fields.description: Gemini-suggested row classification (Phase 4 dual-AI pass -- Gemini second opinion, blind to the parser's verdict). Written only by the Gemini service / gemini accept-reject endpoint, never by the parser or human edit layer. An accept folds the value into the human layer (mirrors the Claude ai_* flow); resolve_effective does NOT read this column directly.
fields.label: Gemini Suggested Classification

fields.description: Gemini-suggested parent row index. Same sentinel convention as parent_index / human_parent / ai_suggested_parent: -1 = no suggestion / root, >= 0 = a real suggested parent row index.
fields.label: Gemini Suggested Parent Index

fields.description: Gemini suggests this row become a top-level root. Written from a null parent_id in the Gemini output. Distinct from gemini_suggested_parent = -1, which means 'no parent suggestion'.
fields.label: Gemini Suggested Root

fields.description: Gemini-suggested level, derived server-side from the gemini_suggested_parent chain. Stored value; display only, not used by resolve_effective.
fields.label: Gemini Suggested Level

fields.description: Lifecycle of the Gemini suggestion. Blank / Pending / Rejected = not in force; Accepted = the suggestion was folded into the human layer via the gemini accept endpoint. At most one of ai_suggestion_status / gemini_suggestion_status is Accepted per row (switching auto-reverts the other).
fields.label: Gemini Suggestion Status

fields.description: Per-row snapshot of the pre-accept state (row + any children the accept moved), captured on a Gemini-accept Save. Read by revert_gemini_acceptance to restore the row; cleared on a later human edit or on finalize. Mirrors ai_accept_snapshot. Written only by the backend.
fields.label: Gemini Accept Snapshot

fields.description: Back-pointer: on a child moved by a Gemini-accept restructure, the row_index of the accepted (owner) row holding the snapshot. Mirrors ai_snapshot_owner. -1 = not a snapshotted child.
fields.label: Gemini Snapshot Owner Row

fields.description: Audit-only record of which Source the row's in-force structural decision came from: parser (default / untouched), claude, gemini, or manual. Written by the accept / save_review_edit / revert endpoints; NOT read by resolve_effective or the commit pipeline. Powers the AI-classifier comparison. A re-run of a provider demotes a row sourced from it back to 'manual' (the accepted value is sticky but no longer backed by a live suggestion).
fields.label: Chosen Source

fields.description: For origin=revision review rows (ADR-0014 D6/D7, AMENDMENT B 2026-07-20): 'Copied' iff the row sat at the same Excel row with the same description as the original AND its parent did too, in which case it copied the original's effective classification AND parenting together (both or neither). 'Needs Review' (S2) is every OTHER content row of a revision sheet, always paired with a `revision_review_reason`; it renders red and must be affirmed before the sheet can be finalized. Blank means not a revision row at all -- every upload/template row (byte-identical) and every spacer, which renders 'Original'. Set at the post-parse merge seam. Matched/New/Ambiguous/Drifted are RETIRED: never written again, retained only so legacy rows still validate.
fields.label: Revision Carry Status
fields.options:
Copied
Needs Review
Matched
New
Ambiguous
Drifted

fields.description: S2 (revision needs-review): the machine code naming WHY this row did not carry -- one of row_inserted / position_shifted / description_changed / parent_not_carried / duplicate_position / no_excel_position / source_unclassified. The vocabulary lives in services/boq_revision/reasons.py; the prose lives in the frontend so wording can change without a migration. Blank off a revision and on every Copied row. Data, not Select, so a new code needs no schema change (mirrors `classification`).
fields.label: Revision Review Reason

fields.description: S2: for a position_shifted row, how far it moved -- CUMULATIVE (counting every edit above it), positive = pushed down. 0 means not applicable, which is unambiguous here: a real shift can never be 0 (offset 0 means same position, which would have MATCHED). With `revision_shift_anchor` it keys the shift block for the bulk affirm.
fields.label: Revision Shift Delta

fields.description: S2: the revised Excel row where the insertion/deletion that caused this row's shift begins -- the block id, shared by the block's collateral rows AND the inserted rows that caused it, so the warnings panel can state one event instead of one line per row. 0 = not applicable (Excel rows are 1-based, so 0 is never a real anchor).
fields.label: Revision Shift Anchor

fields.description: S2/S3: the reviewer's 'Looks OK' affirmation on a Needs Review row. Written ONLY by affirm_revision_row / affirm_revision_block and auto-set by a classification or parent edit; deliberately NOT by a value edit (a quantity fix says nothing about classification). Kept SEPARATE from flags_dismissed, which acknowledges the parser's advisory flags -- a row can carry both, and one tick must not clear the other. The finalize gate blocks on Needs Review rows where this is 0.
fields.label: Revision Reviewed
